ui.chat.ask_command.copy.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.copy.role: button in the suggested-command row that copies the command to the clipboard

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_caution.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_caution.role: caution line in the run dialog asking the user to read the agent's command before running it
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_caution.tone: two short sentences, direct, not alarmist

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_closed.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_closed.role: note in the run dialog when the ask closed while the dialog was open; the confirm button is disabled

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_confirm.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_confirm.role: confirm button of the run dialog; types the command and presses Enter in a new terminal

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_device_local.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_device_local.role: dialog line saying where the command will run: a new terminal tab on this computer, starting in the user's home folder

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_device_remote.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.

placeholders.device: the display name of the other computer; never translated

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_device_remote.role: dialog line when the agent works on another device: the command runs here on this computer, not on that device
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_device_remote.tone: one sentence; the dash may be replaced by the locale's natural clause break

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_device_remote.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_device_remote.role: same as dialog_device_remote when the other device has no known name

ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_title.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.dialog_title.role: title of the confirmation dialog shown before a suggested command is typed into a terminal and run

ui.chat.ask_command.insert.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.insert.role: button that types the suggested command into a new terminal tab without running it
ui.chat.ask_command.insert.tone: one verb; must stay short (dense button)

ui.chat.ask_command.insert_hint.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.insert_hint.role: tooltip and accessible description of the Insert button

ui.chat.ask_command.label.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.label.role: accessible name of the row under an ask's question that shows a shell command the agent suggests

ui.chat.ask_command.notice_elsewhere.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.

placeholders.device: the display name of the other computer, e.g. 'Damian’s MacBook'; never translated

ui.chat.ask_command.notice_elsewhere.role: line under a suggested command when the agent works on another device, so the command can only be inserted, not run, on this computer
ui.chat.ask_command.notice_elsewhere.tone: two short sentences, plain and calm

ui.chat.ask_command.notice_elsewhere_unn.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.notice_elsewhere_unn.role: same as notice_elsewhere when the other device has no known name

ui.chat.ask_command.notice_target_unknow.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.notice_target_unknow.role: line under a suggested command when the agent's request does not say which computer the command is for, so it offers Insert only

ui.chat.ask_command.notice_unplaced.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.notice_unplaced.role: line under a suggested command when the app cannot tell which computer the agent works on, so it offers Insert only

ui.chat.ask_command.run.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.run.role: button that opens a confirmation before running the suggested command; the ellipsis signals a dialog follows

ui.chat.ask_command.run_hint.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; the command itself is never part of this text.
ui.chat.ask_command.run_hint.role: tooltip and accessible description of the Run… button
